name: perl-module-loaded
description: This tool manages Perl's internal module tracking to mark packages as loaded or unloaded without modifying the filesystem. Use when user asks to fake the presence of a module, check if a package is registered, or force Perl to forget a loaded module for reloading.
overview: The `Module::Loaded` utility provides a clean interface for manipulating Perl's module tracking mechanism. In standard Perl operations, the `%INC` hash tracks which files have already been loaded to prevent redundant processing. This skill allows you to programmatically "fake" the presence of a module (making `require` or `use` a no-op) or "forget" a loaded module so that Perl attempts to find and load it again from `@INC`.
